column1: # The function record (the contract of the term record and the issuing key's signature, «The function record»): record(keys, row, kinds) → ok {term, holder} | refused <word>.
# input — the input of the command record as JSON text: keys — the trusted document of the set (the domain key set contract), row — the row as read ({doc}).

# The kinds of the command — the three kinds of M11/10 (the term record, the backup document, the grant) and the members row of ADR-0113. expect — a subset of the output or «@exit 2» (the input is out of form).
# The rows — the acceptance inputs of M11/10 inputs/record-*.json, sc. 05.
